name: Hanabi
summary: Cooperative deduction game where players build color fireworks without seeing their own cards, using limited hints.
rules_text: Cooperative 2-5 players. Deck has 5 colors with three 1s, two 2s-4s, one 5 each. Players hold cards facing out, unseen to owner. Setup 8 hint tokens and 3 fuse tokens. On your turn do one: give a hint, discard, or play. To give a hint spend a hint token, choose one other player and name a color or rank; you must point to all their cards matching it. To discard, choose one of your unknown cards, discard face up, regain one hint token and draw a replacement unseen. To play, place a card to the table; if it is the next number in its color (1 starts a pile) it stays, and completing a pile to 5 regains a hint if available, otherwise it fails and a fuse token is spent. Three fuse tokens lost ends game in failure. When deck empties, each player gets one final turn. Score is sum of top card of each color pile.
rating_reason: Specific cooperative card game with hidden hands and clues, turn-based
